slice: Natural conversation round 25: future/prediction questions answered, not treated as a topic
fallback_reply: Hard to say for sure — I can't see the future. But if I had to guess, I'd say a lot depends on what you do next. What are you hoping happens?

before.what do you think will happen next week?: I don't have a good answer on happen yet — what's it like from your side?

mechanism: future/prediction questions ('will happen', 'what's next', 'predict') get an honest-uncertainty reply instead of being read as a topic ('no good answer on happen')
